text.en: This Order may be cited as the Constitution (Transfer of Func-Citation. tions and Consequential Provisions) Order, 1987 and shall be deemed to have come into force on 1st January, 1984.
In this Order, "functions" includes any powers, duties, privileges Interpretation. or benefits conferred or imposed by any written law on any person or authority.

The functions conferred or imposed on the person or authority Transfer of specified in the first column of the Schedule by the provisions of the functions. law specified opposite thereto in the second column of that Schedule are hereby transferred to the person or authority specified opposite thereto in the third column of that Schedule.

SCHEDULE

MISUSE OF DRUGS (CAP. 27) First Column Second Column Third Column His Majesty The section 2 The Minister with Sultan and Yang the approval of His Di-Pertuan in Majesty The Sultan Council and Yang Di-Pertuan section 14(2)(c) The Minister section 34 The Minister with the approval of His Majesty The Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan section 35 Made this 20th day of August, 1987 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

HIS MAJESTY THE SULTAN AND

YANG DI-PERTUAN
